class.name: VehicleAudioFiringData
class.brief_description: Authored four-stroke crank phases and waveguide source routing.
class.description: VehicleAudioFiringData stores parallel arrays of phases in degrees, source names, and gains plus a source pulse width. Phases are normalized modulo a 720-degree four-stroke cycle; up to 16 entries are accepted. Each firing event is compiled as a fixed normalized two-exponential pulse using a 15% attack width and the authored decay width. A new resource defaults to the conventional four-cylinder 1-3-4-2 order and a 1.5 ms pulse width.

method.name: set_phases_degrees
method.description: Sets authored crank phases in degrees.

method.name: get_phases_degrees
method.description: Returns authored crank phases in degrees.

method.name: set_source_names
method.description: Sets the waveguide source name routed by each phase.

method.name: set_gains
method.description: Sets the pulse gain for each phase.

method.name: set_pulse_width_ms
method.description: Sets the positive source pulse decay width in milliseconds; setup compiles the normalized two-exponential pulse.

method.name: get_pulse_width_ms
method.description: Returns the authored source pulse width in milliseconds.

method.name: configure_default_four_stroke
method.description: Replaces the arrays with phases 0, 180, 360, and 540 degrees routed as cylinder 1, 3, 4, and 2 with gain 1.

members.member: Finite crank phases; the arrays must have matching lengths and no more than 16 entries.
Waveguide source name for each phase.
Positive source pulse decay width in milliseconds. The attack width is 15% of this value and the compiled two-exponential difference is peak-normalized.
